Frequency once per day

Trigger You end your turn at half your maximum Hit Points or fewer.

Requirement bio-attuned

Your graft tissue surges to close what it can, when it has to.

Regain Hit Points equal to your level. This isn't ordinary healing — it doesn't remove persistent damage or conditions, only lost Hit Points.
